entry.label: Serialized local notes for this widget instance.

entry.label: Interface language code: en, ru, es, id, de, fr, pt, zh, ja or hi.

entry.label: Direction in which the fan opens from the screen edge.

entry.label: Screen edge to which sticks are attached.

entry.name: idleDisplayMode

entry.name: fixedNoteWidth
entry.label: Shared fixed width used by every note card.

entry.name: fixedNoteHeight
entry.label: Shared fixed height used by every note card.

entry.name: paletteJson
entry.label: User-configured ordered paper palette. The first colour is mandatory.

entry.name: noteFontSize
entry.label: Base text size for note bodies, in pixels.

entry.name: noteFontFamily
entry.label: Manual font family used only after disabling the system font option.

entry.name: useSystemNoteFont
entry.label: Use the current Plasma system font for note titles and bodies.

entry.name: appearanceMode
entry.label: Visual system: noty, adaptive or plasma.

entry.label: Experimental opt-in to resolve action icons from the active Plasma icon theme.

entry.label: How long timestamped archived notes remain recoverable before permanent removal.
